texts: Each Keeper takes the sea-water from the Salt-bloom Tide-pools.

fields.sentence: Each Keeper takes the sea-water from the Salt-bloom Tide-pools.

q2_gaps: A plural-headed multi-word proper name naming a SET of things ("the Salt-bloom Tide-pools"): the multi-word-name rule supplies only the singular template (Member <name> <kind>) ("the Kestrel River"), while the capitalized-plural-label carve-out bars GroupOf and any per-member kind from the label word, so there is no licensed way to record that the named referent is plural rather than one individual of that kind.
review.notes: Bare "each N V" rule with Skolem-function event, QuantifierPhrase companion, Theme/Source roles, definite-witness sea-water and compound genus atoms all follow the instruction set; no capability atom for the referring nominalization "keeper", which is correct.
